page.overview:
What is G-1?

G-1 is a Marine Base that was located in the New World, now located on Paradise's Marineford (where Marine Headquarters used to be), where Vice Admiral Momonga is stationed — part of One Piece.

After the events of the Summit War of Marineford, the base switched locations with the Marine Headquarters at Marineford, as Fleet Admiral Sakazuki desired to have the Headquarters in the sea where the Four Emperors were in order to challenge their domination within the second half of the Grand Line. Its former location, now called New Marineford, is said to be exactly symmetrical to Marineford on the other side of the Red Line.
